value: U.S. Department of Energy, Advanced Manufacturing Office; prepared by Energetics Incorporated (2018). Understanding the 2014 Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints. Companion document to the 2014 MECS Manufacturing Energy and Carbon Footprints (September 2018), 5 pp.

Methodology companion to the 2014 MECS footprint diagrams (doe_2018_001); no technology parameters. Reader's guide to the footprint diagrams: what each box and flow means, and how primary, offsite and onsite energy relate. Copied 2026-10-08 from the modeller's N:\CIMS\Sources\Technologies\EIA MECS\2014 folder (download name understanding-2014-manufacturing-energy-and-carbon-footprints.pdf).
